text:
Type: three-seat sofa with rolled arms
Use: seating, lounging; living room, family room
Style: traditional, classic, Scandinavian
Materials: woven fabric upholstery, turned light wood legs
Colors: dark charcoal grey, natural light wood legs
Shape: low scrolled arms, two loose back cushions and two seat cushions, piped edges, turned tapered legs, medium visual weight
Feel: cozy, elegant, warm
Goes with: light wood, white walls, cream and mustard textiles; classic, Scandinavian or traditional living rooms

product.name: STOCKSUND
product.description: You get extra soft comfort and support because the thick cushion has a core of pocket springs and a top of cut foam and polyester fibres.
